manaNeeded: {6}{R/G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human nontoken creature.
description:
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all nonland permanent cards from your library.
Cast Illuna either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R/G}{U}{U} and command tax, if applicable, putting it over or under a non-Human nontoken creature you control.
Illuna triggers, exiling your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
